title: Burgundy Beef in Skillet
description: A classic French-inspired dish made with tender beef, onions, and a rich burgundy wine sauce. Serve over hearty servings of egg noodles.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
4. Add the burgundy wine and beef broth to the skillet, stirring to deglaze.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes.
6. Stir in the flour to thicken the sauce.
7. Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve the beef and sauce over cooked egg noodles.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
